source: 3. CTC breakup Calculator 50% Basic PF CELLING LIMIT-25000 01 OCT 26.xlsx (CGB, sent 2026-11-06)
notes: One structure per sheet: 'Without Gratuity' and 'External'. Each rule is the sheet's formula: Basic =CTC*50%; Statutory Bonus =IF(Basic<=21000,Basic*8.33%,0) (the BONUS wage type, as in the factoHR salary sheet); HRA =ROUNDUP(Basic*40%,0); Transport Allowance 0 (the CONVEYANCE ALLOWANCE wage type); Special = CTC - the rest - employer contributions.
Employer contributions inside the CTC: PF =ROUNDUP(IF(Basic<25000,Basic*13%,3250),0), ESIC =ROUNDUP(IF(Basic>21000,0,Basic*3.25%),0).

Employee deductions: Medical Insurance Premium 239 when there is no ESIC (Basic above 21000) -> INSURANCE; Professional Tax 200 (Without Gratuity only; blank on External) -> PT_MANUAL. Employee PF, employee ESIC and TDS are left to payroll, which works them out each month (and prorates them for loss of pay).
External's Gratuity row is empty in the sheet: kept as a 0 line so it can be given a rule.
